The '''Imperial C-series war droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model that could be seen throughout [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] [[Sith Worlds/Legends|planets]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Their main function was to maintain security in occupied territories, as it served as a portable turret.
